sentences.en: In the 1930s, an unlikely man from rural Louisiana rose to political stardom.
sentences.zh: 20世纪30年代，路易斯安那州乡村出了一位意想不到的人物，他一跃成为政治明星。

sentences.en: Huey Long appealed to working-class Americans with fiery speeches and a populist agenda.
sentences.zh: 休伊·朗以激昂的演讲和民粹主义纲领吸引了美国工人阶级。

sentences.en: He promised free textbooks, better infrastructure, and redistribution of wealth.
sentences.zh: 他承诺提供免费教科书、更好的基础设施以及财富再分配。

sentences.en: While we might have millionaires, and men worth two million, and men worth three million,
sentences.zh: 虽然我们可能会有百万富翁，有身家两百万的人，有身家三百万的人，

sentences.en: maybe, and men worth maybe five or six million, but that nonetheless there must be a limit
sentences.zh: 也许吧，还有身家五六百万的人，但尽管如此，对于任何一个人能拥有的财富上限，

sentences.en: on how big any one man could get.
Thousands gathered to hear him speak.
sentences.zh: 成千上万的人聚集来听他演讲。

sentences.en: His promise to make every man a king soon earned him a nickname, the kingfish.
sentences.zh: 他让“人人皆国王”的承诺很快为他赢得了“金枪鱼”的绰号。

sentences.en: But Huey Long also made powerful enemies along the way.
sentences.zh: 但休伊·朗在这一过程中也树立了强大的敌人。

sentences.en: Critics saw him as a dangerous demagogue.
sentences.zh: 批评者视他为一个危险的煽动家。

sentences.en: They warned that he was crooked, cunning, and completely unconcerned with checks and balances.
sentences.zh: 他们警告说他狡猾、诡计多端，且完全不把权力制衡放在眼里。

sentences.en: He fired those who opposed him, took over state agencies, and appointed loyalists.
sentences.zh: 他解雇反对他的人，接管州政府机构，并任命亲信。

sentences.en: When Louisiana State University published a newspaper article criticizing him,
sentences.zh: 当路易斯安那州立大学发表了一篇批评他的报纸文章时，

sentences.en: Huey Long saw to it that the seven students who wrote the piece were expelled.
sentences.zh: 休伊·朗设法让撰写这篇文章的七名学生被开除。

sentences.en: He was magnetic, dangerous to some, divine to others.
sentences.zh: 他有着极大的磁场，在某些人看来他很危险，在另一些人看来他宛如神明。

sentences.en: He rewrote the rules and dared the system to stop him.
sentences.zh: 他重写了规则，并敢于让体制无法阻止他。

sentences.en: In 1929, after he became governor of Louisiana, Huey Long was impeached on charges of bribery,
sentences.zh: 1929年，在当选路易斯安那州长后，休伊·朗因涉嫌受贿、
腐败和滥用权力而遭到弹劾。

sentences.en: Rather than prove his innocence, he orchestrated a political blockade in the state senate.
sentences.zh: 他没有证明自己的清白，而是在州参议院策划了一场政治封锁。

sentences.en: He persuaded senators to sign a letter vowing not to convict him, which made a trial pointless.
sentences.zh: 他说服参议员签署了一封誓言不将他定罪的信，这让审判变得毫无意义。

sentences.en: He went on to become a U.S.
sentences.zh: 他后来成为了一名美国
他的受欢迎程度不仅没有消亡。

sentences.en: Today on the show, we take a deep dive into the psychological forces that draw us to charismatic figures
sentences.zh: 今天的节目中，我们深入探讨了将我们吸引到政治、体育和宗教界

sentences.en: in the worlds of politics, sports, and religion.
sentences.zh: 具有个人魅力的领袖身边的心理力量。

sentences.en: The science of loyalty and the building blocks of devotion.
sentences.zh: 忠诚的科学与奉献的基石。
本周，敬请收听《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: We often turn to history to understand how the world changes.
sentences.zh: 我们经常求助于历史来理解世界是如何改变的。

sentences.en: We examine the lives of leaders who sparked revolutions and gathered thousands behind their cause.
sentences.zh: 我们审视了那些点燃革命并将成千上万的人聚集在其事业背后的领袖的生活。

sentences.en: We ask, what made these leaders so powerful?
sentences.zh: 我们禁不住要问，是什么让这些领袖如此强大？
是什么解释了他们的影响力？

sentences.en: How did they manage to change the course of history?
sentences.zh: 他们是如何成功改变历史进程的？

sentences.en: At the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill, historian Molly Worthen explores how individuals inspire change,
sentences.zh: 在北卡罗来纳大学教堂山分校，历史学家莫莉·沃滕探讨了个人如何激发变革、

sentences.en: create movements, and sometimes change the world.
sentences.zh: 创造运动，有时甚至改变世界。

sentences.en: Molly Worthen, welcome to Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 莫莉·沃滕，欢迎来到《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: Molly, I want to talk about some unlikely leaders in American history.
sentences.zh: 莫莉，我想谈谈美国历史上一些意想不到的领袖。

sentences.en: Jemima Wilkinson was born in Rhode Island in 1752.
sentences.zh: 杰米玛·威尔金森于1752年出生在罗德岛。

sentences.en: When she was 23, she fell ill and was on the brink of death.
sentences.zh: 在她23岁时，她生病了，濒临死亡。

sentences.en: When she recovered, she claimed to have undergone a profound spiritual transformation.
sentences.zh: 当她康复后，她声称自己经历了一次深刻的精神蜕变。

sentences.en: What did she say happened to her?
sentences.zh: 她说了什么事情发生在她身上？

sentences.en: She reported that she had seen two angels, and they had delivered this amazing message to her.
sentences.zh: 她报告说她看到了两位天使，他们向她传达了这个惊人的信息。

sentences.en: They told her that her body was a vessel for the Holy Spirit, that in fact, Jemima Wilkinson, the 23-year-old human female, had died.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉她，她的身体是圣灵的容器，事实上，23岁的人类女性杰米玛·威尔金森已经死了。

sentences.en: And now her body was a vessel for this androgynous divine presence.
sentences.zh: 现在她的身体是这个雌雄同体的神圣存在的容器。

sentences.en: She stopped dressing like a conventional woman of her time.
sentences.zh: 她停止穿着她那个时代的传统女性服装。

sentences.en: She stopped using female pronouns whenever she could, wore her hair long, and wore a large gray felt hat,
sentences.zh: 只要有可能，她就停止使用女性代词，留着长发，戴着一顶大灰色毛毡帽，

sentences.en: began dressing in a smock that concealed her figure, looked a bit like a dressing gown,
sentences.zh: 开始穿着一件遮住身材的宽大罩衫，看起来有点像晨衣，

sentences.en: sometimes wore a purple cravat, and she launched a preaching campaign.
sentences.zh: 有时戴着一条紫色领结，并展开了一场传道运动。

sentences.en: Her message in the context of the revolution, right, this is 1776, that she has this attack
sentences.zh: 在革命的背景下，对吧，这是1776年，她的这场遭遇

sentences.en: and is reborn as the public universal friend, is a kind of vague one that is compatible with
sentences.zh: 并作为“公开的宇宙之友”重生，这是一个有点模糊的概念，它与

sentences.en: a lot of different theological questions and doubts about existing churches,
sentences.zh: 许多关于现有教会的不同神学问题和疑虑相容，

sentences.en: questions about the end times, that a whole range of followers were having in this era.
sentences.zh: 以及关于末世的问题，这一时期的许多追随者都在思考这些。

sentences.en: And she begins speaking to all kinds of crowds of people who are out of sync, I guess you could say,
sentences.zh: 她开始向各种各样的人群讲话，可以说，他们

sentences.en: in some way or another with the prevailing rhythms of society.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上与社会的普遍节奏不合拍。

sentences.en: She also addresses kind of open-air markets.
sentences.zh: 她还在某种露天市场发表演讲。

sentences.en: If a sympathetic minister will give her his pulpit, she takes advantage of that.
sentences.zh: 如果一个有同情心的牧师把他的讲坛让给她，她就会利用这一点。

sentences.en: And some wander in to hear this unusual person who they can't quite place,
sentences.zh: 有些人闲逛进来听这位不同寻常的人讲话，他们无法完全定位，

sentences.en: maybe they can't quite figure out if this is a man or a woman.
sentences.zh: 也许他们无法确定这到底是男人还是女人。

sentences.en: They can't quite make out the actual import of the kind of vague theological pronouncements.
sentences.zh: 他们无法完全理解这种含糊的神学声明的真正含义。

sentences.en: They see this as a young woman who's kind of put on a costume.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这是一个穿着戏服的年轻女子。

sentences.en: But a surprising number, I mean, eventually a few hundred people,
sentences.zh: 但令人惊讶的是，我的意思是，最终有几百人，

sentences.en: are compelled by the public universal friend's invitation to step out of whatever role you've been handed
sentences.zh: 被“公开的宇宙之友”的邀请所吸引，即走出你在革命时期美国社会中所扮演的任何角色，

sentences.en: by your place in revolutionary American society and find something new.
And so we're talking about followers who range from young women who perhaps had not quite landed
sentences.zh: 所以我们谈论的追随者范围从年轻女性，她们可能还没有完全落脚于

sentences.en: in a family arrangement that was acceptable in society to very established kind of senior men in the community.
sentences.zh: 社会中可接受的家庭安排，到社区中非常稳固的资深男性。

sentences.en: One of her most prominent followers is a Rhode Island colonial judge named William Potter,
sentences.zh: 她最著名的追随者之一是罗德岛殖民地法官威廉·波特，

sentences.en: who puts a lot of his personal fortune to the service of her growing ministry.
sentences.zh: 他将自己的大部分个人财富投入到她不断壮大的传道事业中。

sentences.en: By the 1790s, she is leading a crew of about 400 followers to found a utopian community
sentences.zh: 到了1790年代，她正带领着大约400名追随者的队伍去建立一个乌托邦社区，

sentences.en: that she calls New Jerusalem in upstate New York to fully break from the rhythm of life
sentences.zh: 她在纽约北部称之为“新耶路撒冷”，以便彻底打破革命时期美国普通社区的生活节奏。

sentences.en: in ordinary communities in revolutionary era America.
I want to jump forward to the 19th century.
sentences.zh: 马库斯·加维于1887年出生在牙买加。

sentences.en: Marcus Garvey was born in 1887 in Jamaica.
sentences.zh: 他的青少年时期作为印刷工学徒度过，最终加入了一个

他在欧洲担任了一段时间的记者，然后创立了世界黑人改进协会

sentences.en: He spent some time in Europe working as a journalist and then founded the Universal Negro Improvement Association

sentences.zh: 据我所知，他是一个意想不到的领袖，莫莉，并不是一个伟大的演说家，而且有很多批评者？

sentences.zh: 20世纪初，主流媒体（无论黑白）关注的非洲裔美国人领袖类型

sentences.en: The type of African-American leader that the mainstream media, black and white,
sentences.zh: 往往是受过大学教育、身材高大、消瘦、皮肤白皙、英俊、

sentences.en: paid attention to in the early 20th century tended to be college-educated, tall, lean, fair-skinned, handsome,
sentences.zh: 按照上中产阶级受过白人教育的英语演讲标准来看是雄辩的。

sentences.en: eloquent by the standards of upper-middle-class, white-educated English speech.
sentences.zh: 马库斯·加维绝非这些中的任何一个。

sentences.en: Marcus Garvey was none of these things.
He shows up in Harlem in 1916.
sentences.zh: 他相当矮，体格有点像摔跤手，肤色很深，并不是一个伟大的公众演说家。

sentences.en: He's fairly short, kind of built like a wrestler, very dark-complected, not a great public speaker.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们知道每当他去街角尝试练习时，他都会受到起哄。

sentences.en: I mean, we know that he got heckled whenever he went to the street corner to try to practice.

sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他住在一个狭小、肮脏的公寓里，靠吃罐头咸牛肉碎和豆子度日，

sentences.en: I mean, he lived on cans of corned beef hash and beans in this tiny, squalid apartment
sentences.zh: 当时他正开始试图让哈莱姆的非洲裔美国人对他的泛非团结信息产生兴趣，

sentences.en: while he was beginning to try to interest African-Americans in Harlem at this time
sentences.zh: 随着他的演讲和他的出版物《黑人世界》的出现，

sentences.en: in his message of pan-African unity,
sentences.zh: 我认为很明显，这是对先前关于非洲人民尊严

sentences.zh: 以及与具有惊人燃烧混合作用的其他精神、经济和政治力量联合的需求的信息的真正创造性结合，

sentences.en: was, I think it's clear, a really creative combination of previous iterations of this message
sentences.zh: 特别是当配合加维对仪式和制服的天赋时。

sentences.en: of the dignity of African people and the need to unite with other kind of spiritual and economic
sentences.zh: 他真的，他自己喜欢戴着有羽毛的头盔和紫色、金色和绿色的饰带

sentences.en: and political strains that proved to be this kind of amazing combustible mix,
especially when enacted with Garvey's flair for ritual and uniform.
sentences.zh: 所以，这个运动在短短几年内就发展出了显着的势头。

sentences.en: He really, he himself loved to wear a plumed helmet and purple, gold, and green sashes
sentences.zh: 所以，他对黑人解放也有非传统的看法。

sentences.en: and a kind of military regalia.
sentences.zh: 我想放一段他演讲的剪辑给你听。

sentences.en: So, this movement, over just a few years, developed significant momentum.
sentences.zh: 他想要为一个共同的非洲论点而工作。

sentences.zh: 所以那个录音不是很好，莫莉，

sentences.zh: 他与来自南方的种族隔离政治家、

sentences.zh: 与三K党成员举行了会晤，

非洲裔美国人实现经济自主，

He wanted, in the context of America,

and establishing political independence for people of African descent
sentences.zh: 但这是一个具有巨大吸引力的信息，

sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他非常热衷于唤醒非洲后裔中

sentences.zh: 当我听他说话并阅读他的演讲时，

sentences.zh: 因此，他在追随者中产生的影响在1919年10月发生了一起非常戏剧性的事件后

sentences.en: When I listen to him and read his speeches,
I hear him as kind of a combination of Moses and Napoleon and Dale Carnegie,
sentences.zh: 当时他在纽约的办公室里，一个男子突然冲进前门。

sentences.en: the kind of pull-yourself-up-by-your-own-bootstraps, you know, aspect of that message.
sentences.zh: 莫莉，告诉我接下来发生了什么故事。

sentences.en: So the effect that he had on his followers was magnified

sentences.en: following a very dramatic incident in October 1919.
sentences.zh: 他在寻找加维并且带有武器。

sentences.en: He was in his office in New York when a man burst through the front doors.
sentences.zh: 他开了几枪，向加维开火。

sentences.zh: 以及他们坚信上帝选中了他肩负特殊的使命

In the 1960s, Tim Galway was a nationally ranked tennis player.
sentences.zh: 20世纪60年代，蒂姆·高尔维是一位全国排名的网球运动员。

sentences.en: He was captain of the Harvard tennis team.
sentences.zh: 曾担任哈佛网球队队长。

sentences.zh: 毕业后，他开始在加利福尼亚教网球，

sentences.zh: 凭借他出版的一本名为《网球的内在游戏》的书。

sentences.en: And his message was quite counterintuitive, I think.
sentences.zh: 我想，他的理念相当反直觉。

sentences.en: you've got all these coaches advising you to pay close, deliberate attention
sentences.zh: 你们所有这些教练都在建议学员去密切、刻意地关注

sentences.zh: 正手、反手和发球的每一个细节，

sentences.zh: 不断操练，直到你对每一个细节都绝对正念察觉。
